targets.title: Domains or URLs
targets.description: One domain or URL per line, e.g. example.com or https://shop.example.com/. Duplicates are removed.

checkSsl.title: Check SSL certificate
checkSsl.description: Validity, issuer, TLS version and days until expiry.

checkDns.title: Check DNS & email security
checkDns.description: A/AAAA/MX/NS/CAA records plus SPF and DMARC on the apex domain.

checkSeo.title: Check on-page SEO
checkSeo.description: Title, meta description, H1, canonical, viewport, lang, Open Graph, image alt text, robots.txt and sitemap.xml.

timeoutSecs.title: Timeout per request (seconds)
timeoutSecs.description: How long to wait for each HTTP request or TLS handshake.
